newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil markets closed for holiday.

text.p: The Brent crude and gas oil futures markets on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) were closed on Monday for a national holiday.
IPE Brent and gas oil trading resumes on Tuesday.
June Brent closed Friday 32 cents lower at $17.97 a barrel, more than cancelling out modest midweek gains as gasoline prices tumbled in the United States.
May gas oil closed $5.50 lower at $165.50 a tonne, trimming the prompt May/June backwardation to just 25 cents amid weaker sentiment on European spot markets.
